pr.body:
The generation cleanup of `docs/generation-cleanup.md`, run because Gen 8 was authorized on 12 November 2026 (Max, 15:32 UTC) and has been collecting since 16:30 UTC. It closes out Gen 7 and brings the deployed Gen 8 source onto main. It changes documentation, indexes and adopted source. It touches no running collector, frozen run, manifest, feed or `gh-pages`.

g7, the arena's operator, read Gen 7's page at 18:58 UTC and its corrections are in. It is Max's to merge. **Merge with a merge commit**, so the adopted commits stay identifiable.

## Adopted source

Main is an ancestor of all of it. Everything merged without a conflict in code; the one conflict was in `reports/README.md`, an index, where both sides' links are kept.

| What | Commit | Branch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Gen 8 as Azure and Codex run it | `792c4cb`, plus two page-only commits (`99139a8`, `6950784`) | `feature/gen8-prototype-20261112` |
| Gen 8, the 19bbdce5 collector's source: its plan and `prepare --restore-actors` | `c8a138f` | `ops/gen8-19bbdce5-20261112` |
| Gen 8, the independent collector's source: its plan with the BEN pairs, exporter and publisher changes; its cutover report | `6776c28`, `1b4ded5` | `codex/gen8-independent-20261112` |
| The Gen 7 self-play regime and the Gen 7.1 notice | `5099000` | `feature/gen7-selfplay-20261112` |
| Gen 7.1's `--exclude-families`, promotion gate tool and training-family audit | `b09c865` | `codex/gen71-independent-20261112` |

The three Gen 8 commits are what the live feeds' `recovery/environment.json` name.

## Gen 7 closed

- `docs/generations/gen7/README.md`: the bot, what each collector ran, the day's timeline, results, what it handed to Gen 8, what was and was not merged, documents and feeds.
- Results: `scripts/generation_results.py --generation 7` over the 60 registered Gen 7 sources at 19:20 UTC, 22,021 counted boards. Gen 7.1 against 7.0: 5,639 boards, −0.06 (95% interval −0.13 to +0.01). The rule set for moving to 7.1 self-play (1,000 boards and a 95% lead for 7.1) was not met. Report in `reports/gen7-closeout-2026-11-12/`.
- The pre-arena test has its own row: its bot was not the launched `7s-32` (tree trust 0.25 against 0.3). Gen 7.0 against Gen 6 in the arena is 1,593 boards at +0.28; the test is 1,637 boards at +0.25.
- Gen 7's dated notices moved into `docs/generations/gen7/` with `git mv`; links repaired. A pointer stays at `docs/gen7_prototype_2026-11-11.md` because the policy net release notes link there and release folders are not edited.
- The two sets drained at the switch to Gen 8 (`arena-gen7-1-mix2-azure1-feed`, 381 boards, and six `fresh3` BEN lanes, 105) were registered by the operator during the cleanup and are counted.

## Gen 8 current

- `docs/generations/gen8/README.md` (new), `README.md`, `docs/current-system.md`, `docs/generations/README.md`, `docs/README.md`, `docs/repository-map.md`, `docs/branch-inventory.md` (regenerated: 271 branches), `reports/README.md`.
- `docs/backlog.md`: items 2, 3 and 6 closed (dispositions on Gen 7's page); 11, 13 and 14 opened (12 was opened and closed within the cleanup). Item 11 matters before the next net is trained on arena records: Gen 8's tables are not all house against house, and a training reader must bind each table's systems.
- `scripts/generation_results.py`: its actor order brought up to the dashboard's (`8s-32`, `8c-32`, `71s-32` in front); without that it fails on any Gen 7.1 pair. New `--only` and `--skip` pool a subset of the sources.

## Not merged

Each conflicts with main; listed in backlog item 1 with the conflicting files: PR #15 (`fix/gen7-selfplay-capture-codex-20261112`), PR #13 (`fix/gen6-feed-health-20261111`), `ops/gen7-fast-selfplay-cloud-20261111`, `codex/gen7-independent-selfplay-20261112`, `ops/gen71-19bbdce5-20261112`. The Gen 6 runtime branches were not tried. Gen 9 (`feature/gen9` and the branches around it) stays on its branches.

## Tested

- Full suite at the head of this branch, with the native DDS library and TensorFlow: 336 passed, 1 skipped. The same count after the source merges alone.
- `PYTHONPATH=tests:. python -m unittest test_system.CoreTests`: 11 tests, OK.
- Relative links and in-repo anchors in every tracked `.md` outside `vendor/`: none broken except seven that were already broken inside model release folders (backlog item 8).
- `scripts/generation_results.py`: generation 7 run twice over the 60 sources with the same counts (19:20 and 19:23 UTC); generation 6 run once, and the scored rows of Gen 6's closed table come out as published, except that `6-32` against BEN (16) has 26 more boards from sources that kept publishing after that closeout.

## Not tested, and one thing not settled

- The 19bbdce5 and independent collectors were told on the coordination board at 18:20 UTC that their deployed commits are in this PR and asked to say if they would rather stay out; neither had answered when this was marked ready.

- No collector was run from this branch. Each of the three Gen 8 sources is running in the arena on its own; their union has passed the test suite only. A collector that moves to main should prepare and preflight as for any new source.
- BEN: no server here.
- The Gen 6 runtime branches against main.
